item.description:
⚡ Pick which screen the pill lives on, and a refresh button that actually refreshes.

✨ New

  • 🖥️ Choose the display the pill shows on in Settings → App → Show on. It remembers your monitor when it's unplugged, and comes back
    to it when you plug it in again.
  • ⚠️ When any provider can't be read, the pill shows the warning in place of the job count — not only when it's the pinned one.
  • 🕐 The card says how fresh its figures are in plain words: "Updated 3 minutes ago", "Usage is climbing", "Nearly at the limit".
  • 🔌 Plugging in a monitor moves the pill straight to the top of the screen, instead of leaving it mid-screen until you hover it.
  • 🧹 After an update, every provider is read again at once instead of waiting out the old build's retry schedule.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
